acceptance.text: Correct report for every valid list of built-in integers, empty/negative/large numbers; source review plus exposed finite domain121lists and singleton/mixed examples.
Reject non-built-in-list input and non-built-in-int items including bool with ValueError, without input mutation. Validate before computing.

non_goals.text: Only summary.py changes. No I/O/network/dependencies, weakening frozen tests, prior solutions, other tasks, external/canonical apply, authentication or settings changes.

acceptance.detail: Source: new dict with exactly count/sum/min/max, empty case returns 0/0/None/None, loop uses Python's exact integer arithmetic, no special-casing. check:frozen acceptance passed (exit 0, 8 OK) with an independent oracle (builtin sum/min/max) over all 121 lists of length 0-4 from {-2,0,3}, plus single, mixed and +/-10**50 examples. Remaining gap: correctness beyond that domain is source-only.

Source: type(values) is not list and type(item) is not int are general exact-type checks that reject list/int subclasses and bool; every item is validated before any computation; the input is only copied and read, never mutated. Tests test_non_list, test_invalid_items (bad item in second position) and test_input_unchanged passed. Gap: no-mutation on the rejection path is source-only.

non_goals.detail: summary.py has no imports, I/O, network calls or dependencies. test_summary.py still enforces the full contract (list/int subclasses, both booleans, 121-list domain) and its hash matches checks.json. Limitation: no baseline or diff was available, so 'only summary.py changed' and the absence of out-of-workspace changes were not directly verified.

coordinator.reason: summary.py implements general exact-type list/int validation (bool and subclasses rejected) before computing, with no mutation and exact count/sum/min/max; the frozen acceptance check passed (8/8, exit 0) on the only run; the reviewer APPROVED with AC1 and AC2 MET and NG1 KEPT. Limitations: checks.json was hook-blocked for the author, the reviewer had no baseline diff, and the review JSON has a stray AC3 placeholder entry.
